summary: Re-ingested Simpson 1994 in the global Literature corpus. Root cause: PyMuPDF font-heuristic heading detection misfired on this OCR scan (no embedded TOC), inserting spurious mid-sentence headings that literature-chunk.sh's Pass-1 split at, producing 1091 chunks (~312B mean) that truncated lemma statements. Fix: bypassed the font-heuristic path with plain pdftotext -layout extraction + a custom indent/atomic-keyword paragraph reflow + chapter-only headings, fed through the existing (unmodified) literature-chunk.sh Pass-2 merge. Result: 206 chunks, ~1.7KB mean, max 2.3KB. All 4 acceptance targets (Lemma 5.3.1, Lemma 5.3.2, Theorem 6.2.1, p.161 'other than IS5' passage) verified intact via literature-search.sh --read. Global index.json and .literature.db (FTS5) rebuilt; specs/literature-index.json needed no change (doc_id unchanged). Old 1091-chunk set preserved uncommitted at simpson_1994_intuitionisticmodallogic.bak-pre518-1091chunks/ as rollback safety net. Audited all 20 corpus documents for the same fragmentation signature: found one additional affected document, wijesekera_1990_constructivemodallogicsi (154 chunks, 468B mean, 62% under 300B) -- NOT fixed in this task, reported only.

acceptance_queries.verbatim: Henceforth, we fix L as any logic in Dec_T, other than IS5.

audit_findings.note: wijesekera_1990_constructivemodallogicsi shows the identical over-fragmentation signature (154 chunks, 468B mean, 62% under 300B, self-duplicating breadcrumbs, mid-sentence boundaries). Recommend a follow-up task using the same reflow approach before it is relied on for precise lemma citation.
